name: Browser sessions open many blank tabs
description:
Reported by the user: browser sessions show "plenty of blank (about:blank) opened tabs", likely created every time the session/browser is (re)connected from the client.

Goal: find why blank tabs accumulate and stop it.
- API: api/codx/junior/browser/runtime.py (and browser/browser_manager.py) - check the connect/attach path and any new_tab / new_page call made on attach, on CDP reconnect or on session resume; open a tab only when the session was created without one (or reuse the first existing page).
- Client: client/src/components/browsers/ (BrowserViewer.vue, BrowserSessionPanel.vue, BrowsersSessionManager.vue) - check for a new_tab call or an iframe/VNC re-init that triggers a tab per mount/refresh.
- Acceptance: reconnecting or reloading a browser session opens no additional tabs; a session created fresh still gets exactly one page; existing sessions with accumulated tabs are not deleted without explicit user action.

Do NOT use project_map/project_locate to discover (the atlas times out in this environment); read the explicit paths above.
